proposal.falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: Reject every preregistered mutation and emit only the declared bounded software, symbolic, formal, numerical, or structural completion.
proposal.hypothesis: A bounded Bundle Protocol version 7 structural refusal artifact can expose declared obligations while refusing unsupported scientific, operational, identity, or authority promotion.
proposal.novelty_against_860_frozen_proposals: No frozen format tribunal isolates BPv7 primary and canonical blocks, lifetimes, fragmentation, CRCs, block numbering, and resource budgets.
proposal.null_or_failure_condition: The artifact omits a declared Bundle Protocol version 7 structural refusal obligation, accepts a preregistered mutation, erases a negative, or promotes a result beyond its evidence lane.
proposal.rollback_or_recovery: Stop the proposal, retain every failed witness, rewrite no history, and leave external, sibling, participant, production, and authority state unchanged.
proposal.title: RFC 9171 Bundle Protocol primary-block, canonical-block, endpoint, creation-time, lifetime, fragmentation, CRC, block-number, resource-budget, and refusal tribunal
